##### Project general facts

Lana on the Park by Nshama Properties is a contemporary residential development located within the vibrant master community of Town Square Dubai. Designed to offer a balanced and family-friendly lifestyle, the project combines modern architecture, landscaped surroundings, and direct access to the parks and open spaces that define the community. Set within a gated environment, Lana on the Park creates a peaceful residential atmosphere where residents can enjoy both privacy and the convenience of a well-connected urban setting.

The development is surrounded by lush greenery and beautifully landscaped gardens, allowing residents to enjoy a lifestyle closely connected to nature. With immediate access to Town Square’s parks, walking paths, and outdoor recreation areas, Lana on the Park is ideal for those who value fresh air, leisure, and an active everyday routine. The project reflects Nshama’s commitment to quality and design, creating a welcoming environment that blends comfort, functionality, and community living.

Each residence is finished in a modern style using high-quality materials throughout, reflecting the project’s clean and contemporary design language. The apartments come with fully equipped kitchens including built-in appliances and are delivered unfurnished, giving homeowners the flexibility to personalize their interiors while enjoying a thoughtfully designed and well-appointed living space.

##### Location description and benefits

Town Square Dubai is a vibrant and expansive mega-development located in the heart of Dubai. At the core of Town Square Dubai is the picturesque Town Square Park, which serves as the central hub for residents and visitors alike. The park features lush green spaces, jogging tracks, and play areas, providing a refreshing escape from the urban hustle and creating a sense of unity and community spirit.

Town Square Dubai boasts a host of exceptional facilities and amenities, making it a vibrant and dynamic place to live. Residents can enjoy access to sports courts, fitness centers, swimming pools, as well as retail and dining outlets within the community. A Town Square Mall, with a variety of shops and entertainment options, further enriches the living experience.

The development's strategic location provides easy connectivity to major highways, ensuring convenient access to other parts of Dubai. Additionally, Town Square Dubai is within proximity to schools, hospitals, and other essential services, offering residents a well-connected and comprehensive lifestyle.
